fusions.name: Fattening Bite
fusions.desc: Snaps at the first enemy in front of you, which deals 4 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Toppling Bulk
fusions.desc: Rears up and falls flat, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of maximum health to a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Burn the Reserve
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Winter Layer
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your ice resistance rises by 10%.
